step_by_step_reasoning: The Lineate Envoy architecture processes healthcare data through a secure multi-tenant pipeline on AWS EKS. Incoming data flows from a Healthcare Source via Layer 4 TCP into an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB forwards traffic to an EC2 instance running HAProxy ingress controller inside an EKS cluster. HAProxy securely routes traffic to dedicated tenant containers running on Graviton arm-based EC2 (m6g) worker nodes. Each tenant deployment uses attached encrypted EBS (gp3) persistent volumes for isolated data storage. Processed and transformed healthcare data is then sent to the destination Healthcare provider. In parallel, containerized integration applications are built via CI/CD pipelines, stored in Elastic Container Registry (ECR), and deployed to worker nodes in the EKS cluster.

edges.notes: Healthcare source sends Layer 4 TCP data traffic to NLB.
NLB forwards TCP traffic to HAProxy ingress controller.
HAProxy routes data securely to tenant container running on Graviton m6g EC2 worker node.
Tenant container stores and processes data using encrypted GP3 EBS volume.
Transformed healthcare data is delivered to destination healthcare facility.
Containerized integration solutions are deployed from ECR to EKS worker nodes.
